Synchronous ingest — blocks until embedded.
Async ingest via Celery — returns immediately.
Batch async ingest — queues all nodes as one Celery task, returns immediately.

Execute the full RemMe query pipeline.

Embeds the query text, runs ANN search in Qdrant, expands seed nodes
via Neo4j BFS, scores all candidates, and returns results above threshold.
Results are scoped to the authenticated user's data only.

- 200 on success (even if 0 results — check `total`)
- 503 if the embedding model is unavailable

post.description:
Send a message. RemMe parses intent, retrieves relevant nodes, and generates a response.

Intent engine extracts: action (observe/suggest/draft/execute), entities, time range.
Unsupported actions (execute) fall back to observe with a notification.
Set debug_intent=true to see the full parsed intent in the response.

post.summary: Chat with RemMe — SSE streaming response
post.description:
Streaming variant of /chat. Returns text/event-stream SSE.

Each event is a JSON object:
  {"token": "..."}        — incremental text chunk
  {"done": true, ...}     — final event with full metadata (session_id, action, etc.)
  {"error": "..."}        — on failure

post.summary: Reinforce a node — reset decay, increment access count
post.description:
Explicit reinforcement signal for a node.

Resets last_accessed to now, increments access_count, recomputes decay_factor.
Use this when the user explicitly interacts with a node outside of a query.
Query hits are reinforced automatically by the query pipeline.

schema.title: Response Reinforce Reinforce  Node Id  Post

post.summary: Run proactive association discovery for the current user
post.description:
Trigger the full association discovery pass for the authenticated user.

Three strategies run in sequence:
  - Semantic: Qdrant recommend API → SIMILAR_TO edges
  - Tag:      Jaccard similarity   → TAGGED_TOGETHER edges
  - Reference: body text scan      → REFERENCES edges

All edges are idempotent (UUID5 IDs) — safe to call repeatedly.
Returns a summary of edges created across all strategies.
Test if the Canvas connection is valid by making a simple API call.
